car.description: Jim Richards / Mark Skaife, 6 October 1991 Bathurst-winning Nissan Skyline GT-R R32 Group A #1 inspiration. RB26DETT twin-turbo six, AWD, Holinger six-speed architecture. Original forest/sand art; estimated Australian race setup, not road GT-R, Spa tune or 1992 winner.
